summary: Square Enix's large-party Unreal Engine RPG, later rebuilt as The Last Remnant Remastered.

entries.title: The Last Remnant

primary.why: The remaster upgrades the game from Unreal Engine 3 to Unreal Engine 4 with improved graphics/features; PS4 is the cleanest high-fidelity current console route.
primary.how_to_play: Play The Last Remnant Remastered on PS4 or PS5 backward compatibility. Use Switch/mobile only for portability, and original PC/Xbox 360 only for historical comparison.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Xbox 360 release with known technical issues.
all_releases.reason: skip: original release, superseded by the remaster and by the improved original PC version historically.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PC version with improvements over Xbox 360; later delisted.
all_releases.reason: skip: historically improved route, but delisted and superseded for availability by Remastered.
primary: highest-fidelity standard archive route among current console versions.
skip: complete remaster route, but lower capture/fidelity ceiling than PS4.
skip: portable touch route, not the best archive capture path.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The remaster is the preferred fidelity route and no platform-exclusive story/content split is documented.

entries.remaster_caveats: The original PC/Xbox 360 versions were delisted; use the remaster for a new public playthrough.
